topic.SONA.ambient 1.001: We did. But the result isn’t important.
topic.SONA.ambient 1.003: No. The ones who lost did.
topic.SONA.ambient 1.x01: And what did your coach say?
topic.SONA.ambient 1.x02: That next time we’re playing Karlova Ves, and they’re a head taller.
topic.SONA.ambient 2.label: What’s the best thing about the club?
topic.SONA.ambient 2.001: When we record something badly, we can hear it again.
topic.SONA.ambient 2.x01: Not Miss Kormanová. She says you should listen to your mistakes too.
topic.SONA.ambient 2.x02: We laugh most at the recording where Adam forgot what he wanted to say.
topic.SONA.ambient 2.x03: That Adam must be a funny boy.
topic.SONA.ambient 2.x04: He is. He just doesn’t know it yet.
topic.SONA.extra 1.001: What have you got in your album?
topic.SONA.extra 1.002: Team photos, certificates and the bus ticket to the district round.
topic.SONA.extra 1.004: Without it we wouldn’t have got there. That’s part of winning too.
topic.SONA.extra 2.label: The holidays
topic.SONA.extra 2.002: Fifteen more days. But I’m not counting them – only the first years do that.
topic.SONA.extra 2.004: I’m counting how many photos I still need for the album. Twelve.
topic.TONO.ambient 1.label: What breaks most often?
topic.TONO.ambient 1.001: Whatever is supposed to go back into place by itself.
topic.TONO.ambient 1.x01: Mainly the door to the yard. It has a spring that’s meant to close it. The pupils have a foot that props it open.
topic.TONO.ambient 1.x03: The foot, so far. We’re on our third spring.
topic.TONO.ambient 2.label: What are the rules here?
topic.TONO.ambient 2.001: Sign in, go only to the prep room and the memory club classroom. And no photographing the children.
topic.TONO.ambient 2.002: Understood. Today I’m even avoiding my own class photo.
topic.TONO.ambient 2.x01: And no running in the corridor. That goes for grown-ups who are late too.
topic.TONO.ambient 2.x03: The caretaker doesn’t run. The caretaker takes a short cut.
topic.TONO.extra 1.label: The boiler room
topic.TONO.extra 1.001: Where do those stairs down lead?
topic.TONO.extra 1.002: To the boiler room. In winter it’s the warmest place, and in summer the quietest.
topic.TONO.extra 1.003: And what happens down there in summer?
topic.TONO.extra 1.004: Everything that broke during the year gets repaired. And sometimes lunch gets eaten there too.
topic.TONO.extra 1.006: In summer the boiler is the best neighbour there is. It wants nothing and tells nobody anything.
topic.TONO.extra 2.label: Noise from the club
topic.TONO.extra 2.001: Can you hear the club all the way out here?
topic.TONO.extra 2.002: Today, yes. They’re recording the sounds of the school, so the children are testing what the doors sound like.
topic.TONO.extra 2.003: They’ve shut the gym door twenty times already. For quality, they say.
topic.TONO.extra 2.005: The door will. The caretaker, less so.
topic.TONO.extra 3.001: So many keys. Can you even tell them apart?
topic.TONO.extra 3.002: You can, by the teeth. Every door has its trick: the prep room you lift, the gym goes left, the canteen needs a gentle touch.
topic.TONO.extra 3.004: The headmistress’s office. The key fits; it’s just that nobody wants to open it.
topic.TRH.ambient 1.label: Original parts?
topic.TRH.ambient 1.001: Original? Everything here’s original. Just not always from the same manufacturer.
topic.TRH.ambient 1.x01: The guarantee is that you’ll find me here. Every day except Sundays, and except when it rains.
topic.TRH.ambient 1.x02: And when it rains on a Sunday?
topic.TRH.ambient 1.x03: Then you’re out of luck twice. But your connector will work all the same.
topic.TRH.ambient 2.label: How much are the parts?
topic.TRH.ambient 2.001: Depends how badly you need them. But we’ll help the school PA.
topic.TRH.ambient 2.002: Even if it ends up announcing tests?
topic.TRH.ambient 2.003: Tests it can announce quietly. Buns, loudly.
topic.TRH.ambient 2.x02: My daughter goes there. It’s the only announcement she remembers all the way through.
topic.TRH.extra 1.label: Miletička
topic.TRH.extra 1.002: Sunglasses in summer, gloves in winter and batteries all year round.
topic.TRH.extra 1.004: Walkmans eat batteries like kids eat sweets. I just keep the stocks up.
topic.TRH.extra 2.label: The mended scales
topic.TRH.extra 2.002: They weigh accurately. So accurately that my customers are suspicious of me.
topic.TRH.extra 2.004: That I had them fixed. Before, they always gave them a little extra.
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.label: Books for travellers
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.001: Have you got anything on time travel?
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.002: Come back yesterday. I’ve just sold the last copy.
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.003: Please, go easy with sentences like that today.
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.x01: Why? Are you sensitive about yesterday?
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.x02: More about tomorrow. I’ve already been through that.
topic.VIERA.ambient 1.x03: Then I’ll recommend something about gardening. Every year is the same there.
topic.VIERA.ambient 2.label: Why keep the supplements separately?
topic.VIERA.ambient 2.001: The book gets sold, the supplement gets lost. So I’d rather keep them apart.
topic.VIERA.ambient 2.002: And have you got a system for family photos too?
topic.VIERA.ambient 2.x01: There’s only one system for family photos: write on the back who’s who.
topic.VIERA.ambient 2.x02: Otherwise in thirty years nobody knows which auntie is which.
topic.VIERA.extra 1.label: Who brings you books?
topic.VIERA.extra 1.001: Where do you get so many books from?
topic.VIERA.extra 1.002: From people who are moving house. After every move I have three more shelves and one less wall.
topic.VIERA.extra 1.003: And what do they sell most?
topic.VIERA.extra 1.004: Cookery books. In the new flat they discover they can cook without them.
topic.VIERA.extra 2.label: How to hold a book
topic.VIERA.extra 2.001: What’s the right way to hold an old book?
topic.VIERA.extra 2.002: From underneath, like a kitten. Never by the spine.
topic.VIERA.extra 2.004: That spine remembers more than the two of us. It needs looking after.
topic.ZITA.ambient 1.label: Have you got today’s paper?
topic.ZITA.ambient 1.001: Fresh news is in the paper for a few crowns. Yesterday’s I’ll tell you for free.
topic.ZITA.ambient 1.002: Today’s will do. For me it’s twenty-five years old anyway.
topic.ZITA.ambient 1.x01: Then put it away somewhere. In twenty-five years you’ll be glad to look at it.
topic.ZITA.ambient 2.label: What’s happening on the estate?
topic.ZITA.ambient 2.001: They’ve repaired the bench. People are complaining it’s freshly painted.
topic.ZITA.ambient 2.002: Repaired, and you can’t sit on it? Which one is it?
topic.ZITA.ambient 2.x01: The one in the courtyard behind the block. On the first day three people sat on it and left in green trousers.
topic.ZITA.ambient 2.x03: There was. They painted that too.
topic.ZITA.extra 1.label: Forgotten things
topic.ZITA.extra 1.001: What do people forget here most often?
topic.ZITA.extra 1.002: Umbrellas, keys and envelopes. Once, a whole cake.
topic.ZITA.extra 1.004: A birthday cake. The owner came back an hour later, just as my neighbour and I were checking whether it was fresh.
topic.ZITA.extra 1.006: It was. He still had half of it left, candles and all.
topic.ZITA.extra 2.label: What’s behind the block?
topic.ZITA.extra 2.002: There? That’s Pri LEALe. A playground, a bench and children kicking a ball over the wall.
topic.ZITA.extra 2.004: Along the side path between the blocks. Just don’t sit on the bench – it’s freshly painted.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.label: How do you know me?
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.001: Excuse me – you’re looking at me as if we knew each other.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.002: Because we do. From the park in Ivanka, in June sixty-two.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.003: Sixty-two? I wasn’t even born then.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.004: I know how that sounds. But you had exactly these shoes.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.005: I bought these shoes last autumn.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.006: And you were looking for paper that writes twice. I sent you to the post office, to Mr Baran.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.007: I’ll remember that. Just in case.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.008: Don’t worry, I won’t ask how you do it. Some things are nicer without instructions.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 1.009: You’re saying that to a repairman.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.label: The park in Ivanka
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.001: Now I know where we know each other from. The park by the manor house.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.002: So it was real. I was beginning to think I’d only dreamt the whole thing.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.003: You sent me to the post office for carbon paper back then.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.004: And you really went. For someone who was seven, I had you listening very carefully.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.005: I had good reason. That paper did the trick.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.006: For me it’s been thirty-three years. And for you?
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.007: Much less. I can’t tell you more than that.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 2.008: You don’t have to. What matters is that you came here too.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.label: The class bell
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.001: That class bell from Ivanka… Did you ring it at the end of the year?
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.002: I did. The class ran off on holiday before I’d finished ringing.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.003: The teacher said nobody had ever started the holidays that fast.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.005: All through June. After that I stopped counting.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.006: You, stop counting? I find that hard to believe.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 3.007: It was the holidays. Even counting gets a day off now and then.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.label: A drawing with waves
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.001: Have you seen a drawing round here with waves and little lines?
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.002: I have. In the spring, children from the school club painted it on the wall with a lady.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.003: The lady had a tape recorder under her arm, and chalk kept falling out of her sleeve.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.004: That’ll be her. Which panel is it on?
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.005: The wall has thirty-two panels. The drawing is on three on the right, right by the passage.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 4.007: I count everything. That’s stayed with me.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.label: Hopscotch on the tarmac
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.001: Did you draw that hopscotch on the tarmac?
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.002: I did. Kubo wanted one, so he’s got one. Eight squares and a half-circle at the top.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.003: And straight lines. I’d need a ruler for that.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.004: You can have a go. But only up to four – grown-ups fall over after that.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.005: Then I’ll stop at three. To leave a margin.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 5.006: Sensible. Kubo jumps all the way to eight, but he doesn’t know yet that he ought to fall over.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.label: The end of the school year
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.001: The children must be looking forward to the holidays.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.002: Fifteen more days. Kubo crosses them off in chalk on the wall, so not a single one gets away.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.003: And you help him count them.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.004: I do. I count how many times the ball flies over the wall, too.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.005: Four times today. The lady on the fourth floor threw it back more crossly every time.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.006: She could keep goal for the team.
topic.ZUZANA95.extra 6.007: She does keep goal. Just against us.
item.LETTER: Gran’s letter of authority. With it, the reading room will give me copies from her collection.
item.LETTER.purpose: Present it to Karol in the archive reading room.
item.BELT_OLD: The drive belt from the school tape recorder, perished into pieces. Pali can tell the size from it.
item.BELT_OLD.purpose: Show it to Pali as a sample.
item.BELT_NEW: A new drive belt, exactly like the sample. Pali got it right first time.
item.BELT_NEW.purpose: Fit it into the cassette deck of the school tape recorder.
item.TAPE_RAW: The cassette ‘Our School’s Sound Atlas’, 1995. The recording’s there; it’s just that two tracks cancel each other out.
item.TAPE_RAW.purpose: Show it to Juro, then play it through the right adaptor.
item.ADAPTER: The circuit is finished, but it lacks a connector and insulation. Juro has marked the contacts with matching symbols.
item.ADAPTER.purpose: Build an audio lead from it.
item.CONNECTOR: From Fero, for mending his scales. The contacts click into the marked places.
item.CONNECTOR.purpose: Fit it into the cross adaptor.
item.BRAID: An offcut of cloth insulation from Milada. Made for a delicate audio cable.
item.LINK_OPEN: The connector is fitted, but the leads are still bare.
item.LINK_OPEN.purpose: Pull the insulating sleeve over it.
item.STEREOLINK: The cross adaptor with its connector and insulation. Ready for work.
item.STEREOLINK.purpose: Plug it into the service input by the school tape recorder.
item.TAPE: The tracks are read correctly and the chronometer protects them. You can hear Lea, and me aged ten. I haven’t overwritten anything.
item.DIAGRAM: A copy of the map of three old measuring points. The transparent overlay is missing.
item.DIAGRAM.purpose: Combine it with the missing transparent overlay.
item.NEGATIVE: A negative of the measuring set-up. Even against the light, I can’t read the supplement number on it.
item.NEGATIVE.purpose: Have Alena make a print from it.
item.CALPHOTO: The shot shows a table labelled K-17. Viera at the bookshop has the transparent overlay with that number.
item.CALPHOTO.purpose: Use it to find the right map overlay.
item.OVERLAY.purpose: Line it up with the node map.
item.NODEMAP: The map leads to Dezider’s garage and to the measuring point on Starý most. Which year it will show, I’ll only find out by measuring.
item.NODEMAP.purpose: Show it to Dezider; needed for the measurement on Starý most in 1995.
item.COIL: An insulated measuring coil. It belongs in the round holder in the measuring booth on Starý most.
item.COIL.purpose: Fit it into the holder in the measuring booth on Starý most.
item.METRONOME: Emil’s metronome, lent for the measurement. Dezider will return it to Emil afterwards.
item.METRONOME.purpose: An independent rhythm for the measurement on Starý most in 1995.
item.KEEPERNOTE: Tóno’s note: the cavity in the low wall is in the 3 × 4 grid, row 2, column 3. When the bench was replaced, he didn’t let them brick it up.
item.KEEPERNOTE.purpose: Find the cavity in the low wall in the school yard in 2020.
item.TEAMNEG: A forgotten school order. Zita gave it to me because Soňa sent me.
item.TEAMPHOTO: The whole team. The boy in the back row looking the other way is me.
item.TEAMPHOTO.purpose: Give it to Soňa for her album.
item.SCORE: Handwritten sheet music: Four Stops. Including the last bars Emil was missing.
item.CHALK: One stick of white chalk. Tóno gave it to me for the approved panel in the underpass.
item.BELLCAP: The brass cap from a child’s bell. It has a thread inside and a scratch on the side from the kerb.
quest.M03.goal: Report to the school on Sokolíkova and find out from Mira what needs doing.
quest.M03.hint.1: Look at the noticeboard outside the school on Sokolíkova.
quest.M03.hint.2: The club is looking for a repairer, and you report to the caretaker. Show him the chronometer with the club’s emblem, then go to Mira.
quest.M03.hint.3: Read the club’s notice on the board → chronometer on Tóno in the entrance hall → topic ‘Trouble with the chronometer’ with Mira in the memory club classroom.
quest.M04.goal: Repair the school tape recorder and take the cassette out without damaging it.
quest.M04.hint.1: Look at the cassette deck of the school tape recorder in the PA room.
quest.M04.hint.2: Take out the perished drive belt with the tools from your tool bag. Pali in Karlova Ves will give you a new one to match.
quest.M04.hint.3: Tool bag on the cassette deck → perished drive belt on Pali in his repair shop → new drive belt on the cassette deck.
quest.M05.goal: Play the original school cassette so that its two tracks don’t cancel each other out.
quest.M05.hint.2: Juro’s cross adaptor needs a connector from Fero at Miletičova and an insulating sleeve from Milada.
quest.M05.hint.3: Cassette on Juro → tool bag on Fero’s scales → topic ‘A sleeve for the cable’ with Milada → connector + adaptor → sleeve + adaptor with connector → finished audio lead on the service audio input.
quest.M06.goal: Put together the complete map of measuring nodes.
quest.M06.hint.1: Take Mira’s letter of authority to the archive reading room in Staré Mesto.
quest.M06.hint.2: Alena will make a photo from the negative from the archive. It shows the number of the overlay Viera has at the bookshop.
quest.M06.hint.3: Letter of authority on Karol in the archive reading room → negative on Alena at the photo studio → photo on Viera at the bookshop → overlay + map in your bag → turn the overlay 180° and confirm.
quest.M07.goal: By measuring on Starý most, find the time window to Ivanka in 1962.
quest.M07.hint.1: Take the complete map to Dezider, the radio ham in Petržalka.
quest.M07.hint.2: Dezider gives you the coil, Emil the metronome. The three digits are on the wall at Pri LEALe.
quest.M07.hint.3: Map on Dezider → topic ‘A metronome for measuring’ with Emil → read the rhythm drawing at Pri LEALe → coil on the holder on Starý most → metronome on the little table → once you have the original cassette, set 3–2–6.
quest.M11C.goal: Check with Tóno in 1995 what he remembers, and in 2020 recover the hidden jar.
quest.M11C.hint.1: Go to Tóno at the school in 1995 and tell him the password ‘The swallow comes back’.
quest.M11C.hint.2: In 2020, after the lime tree was saved, the school yard looks different, but the stones in the low wall still form the original grid.
quest.M11C.hint.3: Password ‘The swallow comes back’ to Tóno in the entrance hall → tool bag on the place of the original cavity in the yard in 2020 → in the low wall, row 2, column 3 → bag + recovered jar → preserved return bridge on Tóno at the service window.
quest.Q3.goal: Bring Soňa a photo of the whole team for her album.
quest.Q3.hint.1: Soňa, in the school yard, is looking for a photo. Talk to her.
quest.Q3.hint.2: Zita at the kiosk has the envelope. The photo studio can help with what’s inside it.
quest.Q3.hint.3: Soňa in the school yard → Zita at the kiosk → envelope with the negative on Alena at the photo studio → team photo on Soňa.
quest.Q3.reward: A page in the school album with the whole team and a short note by grown-up Adam.
quest.Q4.goal: Help Emil find the ending of his song Four Stops.
quest.Q4.hint.1: Ask Emil at the Karlova Ves tram stop why his tune doesn’t end.
quest.Q4.hint.2: Viera at the bookshop has the sheet music with the last bars.
quest.Q4.hint.3: Topic ‘Why doesn’t the tune end?’ with Emil at the Karlova Ves tram stop → topic ‘Have you got Emil’s music?’ with Viera at the bookshop → sheet music on Emil.
quest.Q4.reward: Emil’s tune in the album – and in 2035, in the café too.
quest.Q5.goal: Help Juraj finish the approved panel in the underpass.
quest.Q5.hint.1: Juraj, in the Petržalka underpass, needs chalk for his panel.
quest.Q5.hint.2: Juraj needs white chalk. Tóno at the school will give you a stick.
quest.Q5.hint.3: Juraj in the underpass → after signing in, topic ‘Chalk for the panel?’ with Tóno in the entrance hall → chalk on the approved panel in the underpass.
quest.Q5.reward: A photo of the panel in the album, and later a small reproduction of it in the gallery.
quest.Q11.goal: Fix the bell on Kubo’s bike so he can ring it with the other children at the end of the year.
quest.Q11.hint.1: Kubo, at Pri LEALe, has a bell on his bike that won’t ring.
quest.Q11.hint.2: The bell cap rolled under the blue spruce, and Zuzana saw where. You can screw it on with the tools from your tool bag.
quest.Q11.hint.3: Topic ‘The bell on the bike’ with Kubo → blue spruce at Pri LEALe → bell cap on Kubo’s bike.
quest.Q11.reward: Kubo with his bell and Zuzana’s hopscotch on Sokolíkova in Adam’s album.
puzzle.P02.clue: The map and the overlay both have a hole, a double cross and a square. They line up when you turn the overlay 180°.
puzzle.P02.success: The hole, the cross and the square all line up. The map is complete.
puzzle.P02.title: Lining Up the Map Overlay
puzzle.P02.wrong: One mark lines up, the other two don’t. The overlay needs turning further.
journal.clue.P02: three registration marks and a 180° turn
puzzle.P03.clue: The rhythm drawing and the notebook: THREE WAVES, TWO BEATS, SIX SEGMENTS.
puzzle.P03.success: Original reference found: Ivanka pri Dunaji, 6 June 1962.
puzzle.P03.title: Calibration on Starý Most
puzzle.P03.wrong: That’s not it. The right digits are on the rhythm drawing at Pri LEALe.
